46272-the-journal-of-leo-tolstoi-first-v.creator: Unknown
46272-the-journal-of-leo-tolstoi-first-v.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This inner law is what we call reason, conscience, love, the good, God. These words have different meanings, but all from different angles mean one and the same thing. In our understanding of this inner law, the son of God, consists indeed the essence of the Christian doctrine.

arxiv-1906-03536.title: Linear Dimension Reduction Approximately Preserving a Function of the 1-Norm
arxiv-1906-03536.creator: Michael P. Casey
arxiv-1906-03536.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Michael P. Casey. For any finite point set in D D -dimensional space equipped with the 1-norm, we present random linear embeddings to k k -dimensional space, with a new metric, having the following properties. For any pair of points from the point set that are not too close, the distance between their images is a strictly concave increasing function of their original distance, up to multiplicative error.

arxiv-2201-03047.title: Weighted Cylindric Partitions Thanks: Research of the first author is partially supported by the DFG (Projektnummer 281071066 TRR 191). Research of the second author is partly supported by EPSRC grant number EP/T015713/1 and partly by FWF grant P-34501N
arxiv-2201-03047.creator: Walter Bridges, Ali K. Uncu
arxiv-2201-03047.description: Abstract . Recently Corteel and Welsh outlined a technique for finding new sum-product identities by using functional relations between generating functions for cylindric partitions and a theorem of Borodin. Here, we extend this framework to include very general product-sides coming from work of Han and Xiong.

arxiv-2308-11879.title: Theoretical interpretation of the Ξ ⁡ ( 1620 ) \Xi(1620) and Ξ ⁡ ( 1690 ) \Xi(1690) resonances seen in Ξ c + → Ξ − ​ π + ​ π + \Xi_{c}^{+}\to\Xi^{-}\pi^{+}\pi^{+} decay
arxiv-2308-11879.creator: Hai-Peng Li, Gong-Jie Zhang, Wei-Hong Liang, E. Oset
arxiv-2308-11879.description: Abstract We study the Belle reaction Ξ c + → Ξ − ​ π + ​ π + \Xi_{c}^{+}\to\Xi^{-}\pi^{+}\pi^{+} looking at the mass distribution of π + ​ Ξ \pi^{+}\Xi , where clear signals for the Ξ ⁡ ( 1620 ) \Xi(1620) and Ξ ⁡ ( 1690 ) \Xi(1690) resonances are seen.

arxiv-2309-16619.title: Cubical Approximation for Directed Topology II
arxiv-2309-16619.creator: Sanjeevi Krishnan
arxiv-2309-16619.description: Abstract . The paper establishes an equivalence between localizations of (diagrams of) cubical sets and (diagrams of) directed topological spaces by those maps defining (natural) cubical homotopy equivalences after application of the directed singular functor and a directed analogue of fibrant replacement. This equivalence both lifts and extends an equivalence between classical homotopy categories of cubical sets and topological spaces.

arxiv-2312-04829.title: Metamaterial-Controlled Parity-Time Symmetry in Non-Hermitian Wireless Power Transfer Systems
arxiv-2312-04829.creator: Hanwei Wang, Joshua Yu, Xiaodong Ye, Yang Zhao
arxiv-2312-04829.description: Abstract Inductive wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, modeled as non-Hermitian systems using coupled-mode theory, leveraging parity-time (PT)-symmetric states for efficient power transfer. However, traditional passive relay resonators in these systems can induce additional eigenstates with broken PT symmetry due to spatial constraints.

arxiv-2403-19769.title: Persistent Monitoring Trajectory Optimization in Partitioned Environments
arxiv-2403-19769.creator: Jonas Hall, Christos G. Cassandras, Sean B. Andersson
arxiv-2403-19769.description: Abstract We consider the problem of using an autonomous agent to persistently monitor a collection of targets distributed in a given environment. We generalize existing work by allowing the agent’s dynamics to vary throughout the environment, leading to a hybrid dynamical system.

arxiv-2412-04431.title: Infinity ∞ \infty : Scaling Bitwise AutoRegressive Modeling for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
arxiv-2412-04431.creator: Jian Han , Jinlai Liu * , Yi Jiang * , Bin Yan, Yuqi Zhang, Zehuan Yuan, Bingyue Peng, Xiaobing Liu ByteDance
arxiv-2412-04431.description: Abstract We present Infinity, a Bitwise Visual AutoRegressive Modeling capable of generating high-resolution, photorealistic images following language instruction. Infinity redefines visual autoregressive model under a bitwise token prediction framework with an infinite-vocabulary tokenizer & classifier and bitwise self-correction mechanism, remarkably improving the generation capacity and details.

arxiv-2510-16286.title: A study of general reaction-advection-diffusion equations describing dynamics between target, partaker, and guardian.
arxiv-2510-16286.creator: Madi Yerlanov, Nancy Rodríguez
arxiv-2510-16286.description: Abstract This paper introduces a reaction–advection–diffusion system that models interactions among three actors: a target, a partaker, and a guardian. The framework is versatile, capturing phenomena ranging from the emergence and movement of crime hotspots in urban areas to shifts in public attitudes during critical events as individuals and control units move through space.

britannica-1911-goeje-michael-jan-de.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-goeje-michael-jan-de.description: Article 'Goeje, Michael Jan de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. was born in Friesland in 1836. He devoted himself at an early age to the study of oriental languages and became especially proficient in Arabic, under the guidance of Dozy and Juynboll, to whom he was afterwards an intimate friend and colleague. He took his degree of doctor at Leiden in 1860, and then studied for a year in Oxford, where he examined and collated the Bodleian MSS.

pmc-10769526.title: The complete chloroplast genome of Callicarpa dichotoma (Lour.) K.Koch (Lamiaceae)
pmc-10769526.creator: Quynh Chi Phan, Ryohei Nagasaki, Yuya Inoue, Hiromi Tsubota
pmc-10769526.description: Callicarpa dichotoma (Lour.) K.Koch is a shrub species with distribution from East Asia to Southeast Asia. We assembled and annotated for the first time the complete chloroplast (cp) genome of C. dichotoma. The cp genome of C. dichotoma is 154,110 bp long with the GC content of 38.

pmc-11403430.title: Infected calyceal diverticulum in pregnancy: A rare case
pmc-11403430.creator: Munachiso Amanda Ngene, Haseeb Habibi, Shirice Lesane, Alpha Chidera Amadi, Mia A Taormina, Elias Hohlastos
pmc-11403430.description: A calyceal diverticulum is a transitional epithelium-lined outpouching of a renal calyx which communicates with the main collecting system through a narrow infundibulum. There are two types of calyceal diverticula: type I, the most common, communicates with the minor calyx, and type II communicates with the major calyx or renal pelvis.

pmc-11467146.title: Comparison of the Risk of Diabetic Retinopathy Between Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter-2 Inhibitors and Dipeptidyl Peptidase-4 Inhibitors in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Japan: A Retrospective Analysis of Real-World Data
pmc-11467146.creator: Masaya Koshizaka, Tomoaki Tatsumi, Fumiko Kiyonaga, Yoshinori Kosakai, Yoko Yoshinaga, Mami Shintani-Tachi
pmc-11467146.description: IntroductionDiabetic retinopathy (DR), a microvascular complication of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), is a leading cause of blindness and has detrimental effects on patients’ quality of life. We compared the risk of DR diagnosis with sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) versus dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP-4i) in patients with T2DM in Japan.

pmc-12405237.title: Imaging renal mitochondrial dysfunction in chronic kidney disease: a repurposed role for [99mTc]Tc-MIBI SPECT/CT
pmc-12405237.creator: Soo Bin Park, Chae Hong Lim, So-Young Jin, Yon Hee Kim, Haekyung Lee, Hyoungnae Kim, Hyunjin Noh, Jin Seok Jeon, Soon Hyo Kwon
pmc-12405237.description: Background[99mTc]Tc-MIBI is a conventional myocardial perfusion radiotracer, and is predominantly taken up by mitochondria in a manner dependent on mitochondrial membrane potential. This study aimed to repurpose [99mTc]Tc-MIBI for functional renal imaging to evaluate mitochondrial dysfunction in chronic kidney disease (CKD).

pmc-13063197.title: A Chimeric LBT-GFP Biosensor Exhibits Antithetical Fluorescence Responses to Ca2+ and Dy3+ Binding
pmc-13063197.creator: Jingyao Li, Sandra Oloketuyi, Li-Wei Hung, Nilusha Sudasinghe, Sang-Min Shin, Ramesh K. Jha
pmc-13063197.description: Rare earth elements (REEs) are critical components in emerging technologies, but their mining and refining processes are often laborious, costly, and environmentally damaging. Developing green and efficient separation methods for REEs is crucial. Biomolecular approaches using lanthanide-binding proteins and peptides show promise for selective REE extraction and separation.

pmc-13172866.title: 488 An ethnographic investigation into rural healthcare delivery and accessibility
pmc-13172866.creator: Eva Melstrom
pmc-13172866.description: Objectives/Goals: This pilot study uses an ethnographic analysis to examine provider knowledge, experiences, perception, and attitudes in delivering care in rural, primary care health professional shortage areas. Methods/Study Population: Ethnographic study relying on qualitative methods (semi-structured and open-ended interviews). Study population includes rural healthcare professionals (HCP), including physicians, physician assistants, nurses, dentists, therapists, and pharmacists.

pmc-13240347.title: Spermidine Mitigates Immune Cell Senescence and Boosts Vaccine Responses in Healthy Older Adults—A Pilot Study
pmc-13240347.creator: Ghada Alsaleh, Mohammad Ali, Amir Hossein Kayvanjoo, Feng Liu, Tanaïs Moreau, Sagida Bibi, Lin Luo, Melissa Govender, Miles Carroll, Sebastian J Hofer, Eisenberg Tobias, Christoph Magnes, Loren Kell, Christopher Chung, Yu Deng, Aneesha Bhandari, Lucy C Garner, Thomas Conrad, Liye Chen, Barbara Krons
pmc-13240347.description: Older adults are highly vulnerable to infectious diseases, and vaccines are often less effective in this population because of diminished B and T cell memory responses driven by impaired autophagy, immunosenescence, and chronic low‐grade inflammation. Spermidine has been shown to counteract immunosenescence and induce autophagy in preclinical models, and its levels decline with age in humans.

pmc-13631237.title: Common alleles associated with connectivity within and across the brain’s main functional networks
pmc-13631237.creator: Xavier Caseras, Tom Chambers, Lynsey Hall, Antonio F. Pardiñas, Kevin Murphy, Richard JL Anney
pmc-13631237.description: Previous GWAS of brain’s connectivity have been challenged by the difficulty of best representing the complexity of this phenotype. Here we report the results from a multivariate GWAS approach that allows for a better representation of this complexity, while boosting statistical power. This strategy notably increases the detection of significant signals to 114 independent SNPs, pointing at 315 candidate genes.

pmc-13713942.title: Comprehensive Analysis of RNA Expression and Isoform Diversity Reveals Molecular Mechanisms in Plant Responses to Diverse Thermal Conditions
pmc-13713942.creator: Jianzheng Wang, Zesen Lai, Zhenze Lei, Fang Chang
pmc-13713942.description: Elevated temperatures, including warm ambient temperature (WAT) and high ambient temperature (HAT), profoundly influence plant growth and development. While WAT promotes thermomorphogenesis and stimulates growth, HAT induces stress responses that can inhibit growth. Using Arabidopsis thaliana, we uncovered both shared and distinct molecular mechanisms underlying plant responses to these temperature conditions.
